result: If I had the power to change the world in one way, I would focus on ensuring that every individual has access to clean water and nutritious food. Access to these basic necessities is a fundamental human right, yet it still remains a significant challenge for many people across the globe. By prioritizing this, we could improve global health, reduce poverty, promote economic growth, and create a more sustainable and equitable world.
